rules.sentence: When `WS-BALANCES-OUT` is not `WS-BALANCES-IN`, it performs `1000-INITIALIZE`; performs `2000-NEXT-ACCOUNT` through `2999-EXIT` until `WS-MASTER-KEY` is high values and `WS-REQUEST-KEY` is high values; sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'NEW MASTER OUT OF BALANCE'`; and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When `WS-BALANCES-OUT` is `WS-BALANCES-IN` and `WS-REJECT-COUNT` is more than 0, it performs `1000-INITIALIZE`; performs `2000-NEXT-ACCOUNT` through `2999-EXIT` until `WS-MASTER-KEY` is high values and `WS-REQUEST-KEY` is high values; performs `8000-WRITE-REPORT`; performs `9000-CLOSE-FILES`; sets `RETURN-CODE` to 4; and stops the run.

When `WS-BALANCES-OUT` is `WS-BALANCES-IN` and `WS-REJECT-COUNT` is at most 0, it performs `1000-INITIALIZE`; performs `2000-NEXT-ACCOUNT` through `2999-EXIT` until `WS-MASTER-KEY` is high values and `WS-REQUEST-KEY` is high values; performs `8000-WRITE-REPORT`; performs `9000-CLOSE-FILES`; sets `RETURN-CODE` to 0; and stops the run.

rules.sentence: When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is not `ALL '0'`, it opens `CONTROL-FILE`, `ACCT-IN`, and `MAINT-IN` for input and `ACCT-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; displays `'ACCTMNT: CANNOT OPEN FILES '` `WS-FILE-STATUSES`; sets `RETURN-CODE` to 16; and stops the run.

When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is `ALL '0'` and reading `CONTROL-FILE` finds no more records, it opens `CONTROL-FILE`, `ACCT-IN`, and `MAINT-IN` for input and `ACCT-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-FILE`; sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'NO BANK CONTROL RECORD'`; and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is `ALL '0'` and reading `CONTROL-FILE` finds a record, it opens `CONTROL-FILE`, `ACCT-IN`, and `MAINT-IN` for input and `ACCT-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-FILE`; sets `WS-BUSINESS-DATE` to `BC-BUSINESS-DATE`; sets `REJECT-RECORD` to spaces; builds `RJ-REJECT-DATE` from `WS-BUSINESS-DATE(1:4)` `'-'` `WS-BUSINESS-DATE(5:2)` `'-'` `WS-BUSINESS-DATE(7:2)`; performs `1200-READ-MASTER` through `1200-EXIT`; and performs `1300-READ-REQUEST` through `1300-EXIT`.

rules.sentence: When reading `ACCT-IN` finds no more records, it reads `ACCT-IN`, sets `WS-MASTER-KEY` to high values, and goes to `1200-EXIT`.

When reading `ACCT-IN` finds a record and `WS-MASTER-KEY` is at most `WS-PREV-MASTER-KEY`, it reads `ACCT-IN`, sets `WS-MASTER-KEY` to `AI-ACCT-NO`, sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'MASTER NOT IN ACCOUNT ORDER'`, and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When reading `ACCT-IN` finds a record and `WS-MASTER-KEY` is more than `WS-PREV-MASTER-KEY`, it reads `ACCT-IN`, sets `WS-MASTER-KEY` to `AI-ACCT-NO`, sets `WS-PREV-MASTER-KEY` to `WS-MASTER-KEY`, and adds 1 to `WS-MASTERS-READ`.
